plan.major: Heavy Truck, Transit and Equipment Technology
plan.notes: Transcribed from the official 2025-2026 LATTC General Catalog (lattc.edu). Semester sequences, course codes, titles, and unit values transcribed exactly as published. The catalog does not state course prerequisites for these sequences. Certificate: 48 units, all sequenced.

courses.title: Heavy Duty Maintenance Shop Practices, Engine Fundamentals, and Electrical Systems
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 112A Heavy Duty Maintenance Shop Practices (4) + DIESLTK 112B Heavy Duty Engine Fundamentals (4) + DIESLTK 112C Heavy Duty Electrical Systems (4) instead of the single 12-unit course.

courses.title: Heavy Duty Fuel Injection Systems, Hydraulics, and HVAC
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 122A Heavy Duty Fuel Injection Systems (4) + DIESLTK 122B Heavy Duty Hydraulics (4) + DIESLTK 122C Heavy Duty HVAC (4) instead of the single 12-unit course.

courses.title: Heavy Duty Transmissions, Brakes, and Suspension
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 132A Heavy Duty Transmissions (4) + DIESLTK 132B Air Brake Systems (4) + DIESLTK 132C Heavy Duty Suspension and Steering Systems (4) instead of the single 12-unit course.

courses.title: Heavy Duty Engine Overhaul, Electronic Engine Controls, and Emissions Systems
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 142A Heavy Duty Engine Overhaul (4) + DIESLTK 142B Electronic Engine Controls (4) + DIESLTK 142C Heavy Duty Emissions Systems (4) instead of the single 12-unit course.
